facts.fact: A joint DGSN and Bank Al-Maghrib communique of 7 October 2024 says the DGSN has developed a trusted-third-party identity verification platform, linked to the digital identity system, that gives instant automatic verification in person or remotely.

MAR.note: No enrolment count or share stated.
DGSN develops its own platform, but operation and ownership of the ID system are not stated as such.
A central bank link to ID verification is not a public register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: The 7 October 2024 communique refers to an existing electronic national identity card (CNIE) carrying embedded identification data, part of which is publicly readable, that the DGSN makes available for identity verification.

A protocol signed in Rabat on 7 October 2024 lets Bank Al-Maghrib integrate the DGSN's trusted-third-party identity verification platform into its information systems for in-person or remote checks and read the public data on the electronic CNIE; no verification is yet reported in use.

MAR.note: Only a security-protection agreement for Bank Al-Maghrib sites; no station records stated.
